name: Old Stickfingers
oracle_text:
When you cast this spell, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal X creature cards. Put all creature cards revealed this way into your graveyard, then put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
Old Stickfingers's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
blocked_sentences: When you cast this spell, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal X creature cards.

needs.what: a "When you cast this spell" trigger (spell_cast, source self, active_zones ["stack"]) whose effects can read the X announced for the spell that triggered it, so reveal_until can take amount {"x": true} as "until you reveal X creature cards"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The value {"x": true} on a triggered ability reads trig.bindings["x"], which triggers.event_bindings fills from obj.cast_x; cast_x is written only in stack.resolve when the spell resolves, and the SPELL_CAST event payload fired by Game._cast carries no x key (EVENT_BINDING_KEYS forwards x only for cycle). So at cast time the trigger reads 0 and reveals nothing. Approximating X through mana_spent_of minus the printed {B}{G} is wrong under cost reductions or alternative costs. The rest of the card is expressible: reveal_until with objects {types: [Creature]}, destination graveyard and its default random bottoming, and a set_pt static counting {controller: you, types: [Creature], zone: graveyard}
